title: MAPLE’S PET DINOSAUR SIGNS WITH WARNER MUSIC AUSTRALIA / IN BLOOM
summary: Today, Warner Music Australia and In Bloom are thrilled to announce the. . .
body_markdown:
Today, **Warner Music Australia** and **In Bloom** are thrilled to announce the signing of 15-year-old Australian rock wunderkind, **Maple’s Pet Dinosaur** . To mark the announcement, **Maple** unveils her new single ***‘Child’s Play’*** – the title-track from her debut EP, set for release on October 30. Listen to the new single[HERE](https://drop.cobrand.com/d/MaplesPetDinosaur/CP_single) and pre-save the EP[HERE](https://drop.cobrand.com/d/MaplesPetDinosaur/PRE-SAVE) .


On signing with Warner Music Australia and In Bloom, **Maple** shares: *“Signing a global deal ahead of my debut EP Child’s Play is a dream come true. Dan and the team at Warner Music in Australia have confidently empowered my creative vision and process at home, while Johnny’s A&R chops and personal support, coupled with his team at In Bloom’s global footprint, puts me in a great position to spread the project internationally. I’m genuinely grateful for this level of belief from one of the best labels in the world and I can’t wait to see what we will be able to do together – this will be fun!”*


**Dan Rosen** , President of Warner Music Australasia and Southeast Asia, says: *“I’m thrilled to welcome Maple to Warner Music Australia in partnership with In Bloom. Since meeting Maple, I have been blown away by her creative vision, global ambition and a deep connection to her fans. We’re excited to bring Maple’s music to the world as she steps into the next chapter of her career.”*


**Johnny Minardi** , President of In Bloom continues: *“Maple’s music felt special from the very first listen. Thankfully, she had a handful of new songs that painted a complete picture of her unique creative vision. She’s a true force of nature, with a rare combination of talent, conviction, and relentless drive. We’re thrilled to help bring the world of Maple’s Pet Dinosaur to many, many, more people!”*


In exciting news, **Maple** has also signed with **Raw Power Management** who represent international artists including, **Bring Me The Horizon, The Mars Volta,** and **Bullet For My Valentine,** she has also signed with leading global talent agency **CAA.**


Today’s new single, ***‘Child’s Play’*** , is written from **Maple’s** perspective as a teenage girl, navigating adult, often male-dominated festival and club environments. *“Lyrically, this song takes metaphorical revenge on people who don’t take you seriously because of your age (or anything else)”* **Maple** shares *. “I think it’s a concept that can translate to anyone who has ever felt like they are being kept in their box – I hope it inspires them to pick up a machete and cut their way out”.*


The track ** opens with a detuned, discordant riff, stacked over a mountain of drums courtesy of **Dan** **Stivens** (Ocean Sleeper). **Maple** moves from rap-like cadence and clever wordplay into a crescendo of vocal runs she credits to unexpected influences. *“I thought it would be fun to fuse Ariana Grande or Xtina-style vocal runs over something really dirty and heavy. I love exploring new ideas inside heavy, alt-metal – or whatever people want to define my genre as.”*


[WATCH THE MUSIC VIDEO FOR ‘CHILD’S PLAY’ HERE](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kque-11H5FM)


In less than 12 months, **Maple** has gone from uploading DIY videos online to becoming one of the country’s most talked-about emerging artists. Blending heavy ’90s alt-metal riffs, soaring emotive vocals, razor-sharp lyricism and a warped VHS-horror aesthetic, **Maple** has carved out a sound and identity entirely her own.


Her breakthrough arrived in August 2025 when a zero-budget music video for debut single ***‘***[lego](https://youtu.be/FUjAQkWCr1w?si=N5Jc55alI5Xsm4uQ) ***’,*** filmed on a Ring doorbell camera, exploded across social media. The clip became the most-viewed Instagram music video reel ever by an Australian-born artist, generating more than **55 million views** on the platform, alongside over **1 million TikTok likes** and millions more views across YouTube. Building on the success of ***‘lego’,*** **Maple** used her follow-up single *‘* ***chorus*** *’* to secure live opportunities, quickly establishing herself as a formidable new talent on stage.


Reflecting on the aftermath of the viral video, **Maple** said, *“I was offered so many opportunities to rinse the doorbell video – fly to the US for talk shows and stuff like that – but that video was only ever meant to be a gateway for gigs. I’m not trying to be a celebrity or influencer. I want to be a rock singer, and the best way to do that is by playing shows.”*


From performing her third-ever show at **SXSW** **Sydney** to becoming the youngest artist ever to appear at Australia’s premier alternative festival **Good** **Things** – sharing stages with heavyweights like **Tool** and **Weezer** along the way – **Maple’s Pet Dinosaur** has rapidly established herself as one of Australia’s most exciting emerging live acts. Earning rave reviews from media including **Rolling** **Stone** , she has since delivered main stage performances at **Groovin The Moo** and Darwin’s iconic **Bass In The Grass** , while also securing a spot aboard Australia’s premier metal cruise, **Hellbound** . As word continues to spread, live performance clips circulating online have attracted co-signs from global heavy music icons **Fred** **Durst** and **Yungblud** , further cementing Maple’s status as a rising force in the alternative music scene.


With 2026 gearing up to be another massive year for **Maple’s Pet Dinosaur** , stay tuned for more exciting news soon.
